name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
benefit: Rs. 6,000 / year direct benefit transfer (DBT)
eligibility: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names (subject to exclusion criteria).

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
benefit: Subsidized premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for annual horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including loanee and non-loanee farmers.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
benefit: Credit up to Rs. 3 Lakh at effective 4% p.a. interest rate with prompt repayment incentive.
eligibility: All farmers, individual/joint borrowers, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers.

name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
benefit: 40% to 50% subsidy on tractors, harvesters, laser levelers, rotavators, and sprayers.
eligibility: Individual farmers, FPOs, Cooperatives, and Rural Entrepreneurs.

name: PM-KUSUM (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan)
benefit: Up to 60% capital subsidy (30% Central + 30% State Govt) with 30% bank loan.
eligibility: Individual farmers, Water User Associations, and FPOs in off-grid or grid-connected areas.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
benefit: Rs. 50,000 per hectare over 3 years (Rs. 31,000 for organic inputs via DBT).
eligibility: Farmers forming a cluster of 50 or more farmers with 50 acres of contiguous land.

name: PMKSY - Per Drop More Crop (Micro Irrigation)
benefit: 55% subsidy for Small & Marginal farmers, 45% for other farmers on micro-irrigation systems.
eligibility: All landholding farmers with assured irrigation source.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
benefit: 3% interest subvention per annum up to Rs. 2 Crore for maximum period of 7 years.
eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), Marketing Cooperatives, FPOs, Agri-entrepreneurs, Startups.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free comprehensive soil nutrient analysis (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC).
eligibility: All farm landholdings in India.

name: UP Paradarshi Kisan Seva Yojana
benefit: 40% to 50% direct subsidy credited to bank account for certified seeds and equipment.
eligibility: Registered farmers on UP Agriculture portal with Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (MP)
benefit: Rs. 6,000 per year in three installments (making total annual income support Rs. 12,000).
eligibility: All farmers in Madhya Pradesh eligible for and receiving PM-KISAN benefits.

name: Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojana (MP)
benefit: Direct cash compensation for price difference up to MSP.
eligibility: Registered farmers selling notified crops in MP APMC mandis during notified procurement season.

name: Bhavantar Bharpai Yojana (BBY Haryana)
benefit: Deficit payout if market wholesale price falls below benchmark cost.
eligibility: Horticultural farmers registered on the Meri Fasal Mera Byora portal.

name: Mera Pani Meri Virasat (Haryana)
benefit: Rs. 7,000 per acre financial incentive directly transferred.
eligibility: Farmers in groundwater over-exploited blocks who replace paddy cultivation.

name: Namo Shetkari Mahasanman Nidhi (Maharashtra)
benefit: Rs. 6,000 / year (combined Rs. 12,000 with PM-KISAN).
eligibility: All landholding farmers eligible for PM-KISAN in Maharashtra.

name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Mitra Urja Yojana (Rajasthan)
benefit: Up to Rs. 1,000 per month (max Rs. 12,000 per year) subsidy credited directly against farm power bill.
eligibility: Metered agricultural electricity consumers in Rajasthan with non-defaulter status.

name: YSR Rythu Bharosa - PM KISAN (Andhra Pradesh)
benefit: Rs. 13,500 per year per farmer family in 3 installments.
eligibility: Landowner farmer families, tenant farmers (CCRC holders), and RoFR tribal cultivators in AP.

name: Rythu Bandhu & Rythu Bima (Telangana)
benefit: Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 7,500 per acre per season (Rs. 10,000-15,000/year) + Rs. 5 Lakh Rythu Bima life cover.
eligibility: Pattadar passbook holders and recorded landholding farmers in Telangana.

name: Krishak Bandhu (West Bengal)
benefit: Rs. 10,000 per year (for 1+ acre) in two installments + Rs. 2 Lakh life insurance grant.
eligibility: All farmers and recorded bargadars (sharecroppers) aged 18-60 years in West Bengal.

name: Raitha Siri & Krishi Bhagya (Karnataka)
benefit: Rs. 10,000 per hectare incentive for millet cultivation; up to 80-90% subsidy on farm ponds.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating minor millets (ragi, foxtail, little millet) or farming in rainfed taluks.
